sunburst.verdict: Every gotcha obeyed: fills the frame, empty grid under the icon row, blank clock, wordless poster, blank spines, closed cage with lid, chair pushed in with its back to the viewer, desk a step from the wall, nothing extra. Balanced across the wall, real sizes, bright. The cleanest picture of three rounds.

seedream-5-pro.gotchas: none, but one new one: the furniture is crowded into the right half, with the left half of the wall empty
seedream-5-pro.verdict: Every gotcha obeyed, including the chair with its back to the viewer and the desk a step from the wall. The 'bare wall to its left' line was taken too far: the bookshelf, desk and cabinet huddle right. That is a prompt fault, number 18 on the list.

nbpro.gotchas: none; the same right-leaning layout as Seedream, milder
nbpro.verdict: The control, clean at last: no stripes, no frame, blank clock, empty grid, closed cage, chair pushed in. Still the flattest hand of the six.

nb2.hard: H3 borderline: the rules poster is on the left side wall, not the back wall
nb2.verdict: Every gotcha obeyed; the poster slid round the corner onto the side wall. Shading a little stronger than round two. The cheapest clean picture.

mai-2.6.hard: H3 borderline: a sliver of window frame at the far left edge
mai-2.6.gotchas: the lettering is gone at last: blank spines, blank envelope, wordless poster
mai-2.6.verdict: The numbered list and the checks line did what two rounds of asking could not: no invented words anywhere. One sliver of a window on the side wall remains, and the chair faces the viewer rather than tucking in. Native size 1360×768.

qwen-2.1-pro.hard: H6 fail (flat wall, no box, third time), H3 fail (objects out of order, bookcase on the right, baskets on the shelves, bookcase running off the edge)
qwen-2.1-pro.gotchas: ignores the room shape and the object order however it is asked
qwen-2.1-pro.verdict: The most lifelike drawing again, and the least obedient. Three rounds, three flat walls, now with the furniture in a different order and storage baskets it was told not to draw. The prompt is not the reason; the model is.

nb2.1.hard: did not run: Google quota (429), third time
nb2.1.verdict: OpenRouter's route to Nano Banana 2.1 is out of quota today. Retry another day or through the Gemini key.
